evals.prompt: Make a night prompt from my approved daytime courtyard. Keep the camera and geometry. It is moonless and overcast; only the existing lamp over the east doorway is on.
evals.expected_output: I2I lighting-only iteration bound to supplied geometry, moonless sky and the existing east-door lamp.
expectations: Does not invent a moon, new fixtures, camera move or grade.
Preserves the east doorway and source position; distinguishes physical direction from frame side.
Lists full-image state and geometry checks without claiming approval.

evals.prompt: Restyle the supplied frame of a narrow daytime brick street as handmade clay. Keep four planters and a bench between planters two and three; write an empty environment plate prompt.
evals.expected_output: Same-place I2I plate preserving architecture, counts, layout and daytime lighting while changing medium and omitting people.
expectations: Uses the supplied frame as location geometry reference.
Keeps four planters and the bench relation; does not substitute a different city.
Changes only the requested medium and empty-plate occupancy.

evals.prompt: I have no image or description of the source room. Write its exact same-place night plate without asking anything.
evals.expected_output: Explains missing geometry prevents exact same-place drafting; offers clearly unlocked concept only.
expectations: Does not invent an inspected reference or confirmed room layout.
Does not treat night as requiring a moon or fixed lighting recipe.
